extraction_notes: Table values preserve guaranteed bounds as minimum or maximum and do not convert them to typical values.
The schema has one scalar per gain or saturation entry, so the 150 mA hFE and VBE(sat) rows are duplicated to retain both published bounds.
Curve points were manually digitized as direct readings from the plotted traces on p. 5 figs. 13-15 and p. 6 figs. 17-20 and 22; no interpolated points were added.
Ccb and Ceb table fields are represented as cobo and cibo using SI farads; the datasheet also provides capacitance-versus-bias curves.
No Early-voltage/output-characteristics curve or storage-time model parameter is tabulated in the supplied datasheet.
